programmes.d: Dario Romano is found dead by his son at the bottom of the attic ladder. What happened to this 45-year-old? With Dr. G’s guidance, Dr. Stephany must solve the mystery.
Keith Douglas is met with a barrage of bullets as he opens his door. The police are looking to Dr. G for hard evidence to link certain suspects to the murder.
Rebecca Davis is found dead in her bed after she fails to show up for work. Dr. G must race against the clock to find out what took this young woman’s life.
Eugenie Ademola is loving her new life in the US when she dies unexpectedly. It’s up to Dr. G to bring closure to Eugenie’s family, but the autopsy results are shocking.
A pregnant teen is admitted to a mental hospital after threatening suicide but is found dead days later. Dr. G must dig deep to uncover what took Claudia’s life.
The four farmers and their remaining ladies go to a barn dance in Tallahassee, Florida.
The four farmers go on their final dates on the farms with the women they chose.
The guys swap the comforts of their farms for visits to the cities of their final ladies.
The farmers continue the home visits with their ladies; a farmer worries he made a mistake.
The farmers declare who have won their hearts; difficult goodbyes lead to heartfelt confessions.
The quest for true love begins in Alabama, where four new farmers begin their search for a soulmate.
A young boy is brought in again after being chronically ill, but is there a reason for this or is the mother poisoning her child for attention.
Two gang members threaten to kill Dr. Carroll while he tries to save three men with gunshot wounds; reattaching fingers; car burglar.
Dr. Castillo thought he had seen it all in the ER, until a seven-foot tall man is brought into the ER, blind drunk and unconscious.
Dr. Michos has his hands full when ten critically ill teenagers are brought in after an experiment with a certain type of drug goes horribly wrong.
A woman complaining of abdominal pain finds out that she is in fact pregnant.
See what happens when neurosurgeon Dr. Smith is under extreme pressure when a young boy punctures his skull with a pitchfork.
A 21-year-old man has suffered internal injuries in a motorcycle accident. It's up to Dr. William Shillinglaw to save him from bleeding to death.
A woman comes into the ER complaining of severe abdominal pain. To doctor's amazement she claims there's an alien in her stomach.
A woman complaining of abdominal pain finds out that she's actually pregnant - but is she ready to be a mother?
It's a busy day in the ER as Dr. Heilbron battles to treat a man whose intestine has come out, as well as car crash and gun victims.
There's havoc in the ER again when a boy is rushed in after breathing in an unspecified poisonous chemical. Has it permanently damaged his lungs?
Crisis breaks out in the ER when a depressed man walks in, pulls out a gun and takes a doctor hostage.
While at dinner, Virginia Lowery chokes on a fishbone. Later that night, she suddenly can’t breathe and dies. Virginia’s family hopes that Dr. G can provide them with closure.
A bipolar man's family fears he took his own life and turn to Dr. G for closure. At autopsy, Dr. G makes a shocking discovery that threatens to turn the whole case upside down.
Cameron Walker finds his dad dead in bed and his mom bound in the closet. When the woman's story as to what happened doesn’t add up, police turn to Dr. G to uncover the true killer.
An 82-year-old woman appears to have committed suicide by overdosing on painkillers, but Dr. G finds evidence that suggests that she may have died of a heart attack.
Dr. G performs an autopsy on an alleged hit-and-run victim but finds no evidence of vehicular injury on the 41-year-old man's body. Could his alcoholism have had a role in his death?
A 94-year-old woman dies in the hospital after having a convulsion. The case becomes the business of the medical examiner's office when no one will sign her death certificate.
